answer_text:
Let

\[
S=\sum_{k=1}^{7}\tan^2\left(\frac{k\pi}{16}\right).
\]

Pair terms whose angles add to \(\frac{\pi}{2}\):

\[
\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)=\cot x.
\]

Thus

\[
\begin{aligned}
S
&=\left[\tan^2\left(\frac{\pi}{16}\right)+\tan^2\left(\frac{7\pi}{16}\right)\right]
+\left[\tan^2\left(\frac{2\pi}{16}\right)+\tan^2\left(\frac{6\pi}{16}\right)\right] \\
&\qquad+\left[\tan^2\left(\frac{3\pi}{16}\right)+\tan^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{16}\right)\right]
+\tan^2\left(\frac{4\pi}{16}\right).
\end{aligned}
\]

Using \(\tan(\pi/2-x)=\cot x\), this becomes

\[
S=\sum_{j=1}^{3}\left(\tan^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{16}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{16}\right)\right)+\tan^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right).
\]

Since \(\tan^2(\pi/4)=1\), we have

\[
S=1+\sum_{j=1}^{3}\left(\tan^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{16}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{16}\right)\right).
\]

Now use the identity

\[
\tan^2 x+\cot^2 x=4\cot^2(2x)+2.
\]

Indeed,

\[
\tan x-\cot x=\frac{\sin^2 x-\cos^2 x}{\sin x\cos x}
=-2\cot(2x),
\]

so

\[
(\tan x-\cot x)^2=4\cot^2(2x).
\]

Therefore,

\[
\tan^2 x+\cot^2 x=(\tan x-\cot x)^2+2=4\cot^2(2x)+2.
\]

Applying this with \(x=\frac{j\pi}{16}\),

\[
\tan^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{16}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{16}\right)
=4\cot^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{8}\right)+2.
\]

Hence

\[
\begin{aligned}
S
&=1+\sum_{j=1}^{3}\left(4\cot^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{8}\right)+2\right)\\
&=1+4\sum_{j=1}^{3}\cot^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{8}\right)+6\\
&=7+4\left[\cot^2\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}\right)\right].
\end{aligned}
\]

Since \(\cot(\pi/4)=1\) and \(\cot(3\pi/8)=\tan(\pi/8)\),

\[
\cot^2\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}\right)
=\tan^2\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right).
\]

Again using the identity with \(x=\frac{\pi}{8}\),

\[
\tan^2\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)
=4\cot^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)+2
=4(1)+2=6.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\cot^2\left(\frac{\pi}{8}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)+\cot^2\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}\right)
=6+1=7.
\]

So

\[
S=7+4(7)=35.
\]

\[
\boxed{35}
\]
